start.title: The Land Is Dry
start.text:
King Ahab burns with anger.
"You troubler of Israel, where is your God?"

choices.feedback: Let the Lord answer by fire.
A prophet must stand and speak.

bow_consequence.title: Stand for the Lord
bow_consequence.text:
Silence is not faith.
The people need to see whom to follow.

choices.feedback: You raise your voice without trembling.

flee_consequence.title: Turn Back
flee_consequence.text:
The Lord did not send you to hide.
Return and summon the nation.

choices.feedback: You walk back into the storm.

carmel_call.title: How Long Will You Limp?
carmel_call.text:
Israel waits between two gods.
"Choose this day whom you serve."

secret_consequence.title: In the Open
secret_consequence.text:
Hidden flames prove nothing.
Let the Lord be seen by all.

choices.feedback: You step back and let them call.

baal_pray.title: No Voice, No Answer
baal_pray.text:
From dawn to noon they cry.
Their altar stands cold and still.

choices.feedback: Let the silence finish its work.
The contest is not yet won.

pity_consequence.title: Let It Be Seen
pity_consequence.text:
Israel must hear the silence in full.
Then the truth will burn brighter.

choices.feedback: You raise your voice with fire.

walk_consequence.title: Stay Until the End
walk_consequence.text:
The Lord's hour has not come.
Return to the altar.

choices.feedback: You face the silent stones again.

elijah_altar.title: Twelve Stones
elijah_altar.text:
You rebuild the altar of the Lord.
The people draw near in hush.

choices.text: Drench it with water three times

oil_consequence.title: Pure Witness
oil_consequence.text:
Trickery would shame the truth.
Let only water touch the wood.

choices.text: Drench it with water three times

light_consequence.title: Hands Off the Flame
light_consequence.text:
Only the Lord may answer here.
Step back from the wood.

choices.text: Drench it with water three times
choices.feedback: The trench fills to the brim.

elijah_pray.title: Answer Me, O Lord
elijah_pray.text:
Evening light falls on the altar.
You lift your voice once, in peace.

shout_consequence.title: Not by Volume
shout_consequence.text:
The Lord is not the storm of voices.
Speak as a son to a Father.

fire_falls.title: The Fire of God
fire_falls.text:
Flame tears down from the sky.
Water, wood, and stones — all consumed.

choices.text: Point them to the true God

credit_consequence.title: Lift His Name
credit_consequence.text:
You did not bring the fire.
Give the people the One they need.

choices.text: Point them to the true God
choices.feedback: You raise your hands to heaven.

ending.title: The Lord, He Is God
ending.text:
The crowd falls upon their faces.
"The Lord — He is God! He is God!"
